description: This file implements an Android activity demonstrating the use of LoaderManager with throttling to efficiently load data from a custom content provider backed by an SQLite database. It includes a nested simple content provider, database helper, activity setup, and a list fragment with options to populate and clear data, showcasing content loading, database interactions, and UI updates with throttling.

classes.name: LoaderThrottle
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating content loading with a custom provider and UI interactions.

classes.name: MainTable
classes.description: Defines database schema and content URIs for the main data table.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: SQLiteOpenHelper subclass managing database creation and upgrades.

classes.name: SimpleProvider
classes.description: A minimal ContentProvider exposing CRUD operations for the main data table.

classes.name: ThrottledLoaderListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment implementing LoaderManager callbacks, options menu, and async database population/clear logic with throttling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, adds the list fragment.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu options for populating and clearing data.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to populate or clear database asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader with throttling to load data from content provider.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates UI with loaded cursor data, manages list visibility.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears adapter data when loader is reset.
